_about: Public-domain Jean Gerson (1363-1429), chancellor of the University of Paris, for the Word Hoard: The Snares of the Devil (1883, translated by "Beta"), the Practical Guide to Spiritual Prayer (1884, translated by H. Austin) and the Treatise on Bringing Children to Jesus Christ (translated by W. Whitty), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 37 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

gerson-snares-devil-1883: The Snares of the Devil, tr. Beta (London and Derby: Thomas Richardson and Son, 1883)
gerson-spiritual-prayer-1884: Practical Guide to Spiritual Prayer, literally translated by the Rev. H. Austin (London and Derby: Thomas Richardson and Son, 1884)
gerson-bringing-children: A Treatise on Bringing Children to Jesus Christ, tr. W. Whitty (title page undated; catalogued Dublin: M. H. Gill & Son, 1899)

_alternates.gerson-copies: CCEL gerson/snares (the same 1883 book); SnaresOfTheDevil (undated copy)

_excluded.gerson-other: Carnahan's French text edition (1917); Connolly (1928) and Figgis, books about him
